tools.name: search_standards
tools.description: Search the WIA standards catalog (hundreds of WIA-authored specifications across industries). Returns id, title, short summary and links. These are WIA's own standards, not ISO/IEC international standards. / WIA 표준 카탈로그를 검색한다.

tools.name: get_standard
tools.description: Overview of one WIA standard by slug: README excerpt (up to 4,000 chars), list of available spec files, ebook languages and links. / 슬러그로 표준 개요.

tools.name: read_standard_spec
tools.description: Read a specification markdown file of a WIA standard (e.g. PHASE-1-DATA-FORMAT.md) in pages of up to 12,000 characters. Use get_standard first to list files. / 표준 명세 파일을 페이지 단위로 읽는다.

tools.name: get_catalog_stats
tools.description: Current catalog counts (standards, sub-standards, simulators, ebooks) from the site's published stats file. / 카탈로그 통계.
